lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And you're sure you saw that, you sure it wasn't another time or anything like that (Brendan shakes head "no"), it was Halloween this year.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: This last year? On the front porch the area?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Do you remember what she was wearing? I know it's a long time ago, don't guess, if you remember, you can say it.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Do you remember how he was dressed?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I think he, er ah, white short, er, white shirt with like red shorts or somethin' like that.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. Anytime you don't remember you say that all right? (Brendan nods "yes")

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Yep, don't make anything up. You don't know it, you don't know it. (Brendan nods "yes")

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: So then did what happened, you saw her and him on the porch and they were what? (Brendan nods "yes")

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And then what did you do?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And they were just talking, were they doing anything else? Were they screaming, fighting, talking, pushing, anything?
